title: Episode 1 — Learn Arabic for Beginners: Full Course

intro.title: What you'll learn
intro.line: In this lesson you'll learn to greet people, introduce yourself, count to twenty, talk about your family, order at a café and find your way, all in Arabic, from zero.

chapters.title: Hello and your first words
chapters.line: First, hello and the ten phrases you will use every day.

chapters.title: Your first conversation
chapters.line: Now let's put those words into your first real conversation.

chapters.title: No word for "is"
chapters.line: Here is one of the nicest surprises in Arabic: there is no word for is.

chapters.title: Yes, no, sorry, okay
chapters.line: Next, the little polite words that make you sound friendly.

chapters.title: Introduce yourself
chapters.line: Now you can tell people who you are and where you come from.

chapters.title: Man or woman: one letter
chapters.line: One small letter changes a word from a man to a woman.

chapters.title: Numbers 1 to 20
chapters.line: Time to count, and to read the Arabic digits too.

chapters.title: Meeting someone in the street
chapters.line: Now a real street conversation in Damascus.

chapters.title: My and your
chapters.line: Arabic has no word for my, so let's see what it does instead.

chapters.title: Family
chapters.line: Next, meet Lina's family, and her cat.

chapters.title: At the café
chapters.line: And now the place you will use Arabic first: the café.

chapters.title: "The": sun and moon letters
chapters.line: Next, the little word for the, and its sun and moon letters.

chapters.title: Asking questions
chapters.line: Now you can ask questions: what, who, where, how many and when.

chapters.title: Finding your way
chapters.line: Next, right, left and finding your way in Damascus.

chapters.title: I drink, I eat, I go
chapters.line: Then four everyday verbs, with one secret letter.

chapters.title: Your body in Arabic
chapters.line: And ten words for your body.

chapters.title: The big conversation
chapters.line: Now everything together: one long conversation, all in Arabic, with the English on screen.

say: Sami meets Lina for the first time, and this is the whole story of the month, in Arabic.

custom.title: The big conversation
custom.card: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامْ. · *wa 'alaykumu s-salaam.* · And peace be upon you.

custom.card: اسْمِي سَامِي. تَشَرَّفْنَا. · *ismii Saamii. tasharrafnaa.* · My name is Sami. Nice to meet you.

custom.title: The big conversation
custom.card: هَذَا أَخِي. هُوَ طَالِبْ. · *haadhaa akhii. huwa Taalib.* · This is my brother. He is a student.

custom.title: Final challenge
custom.card: Final challenge · 8 questions
say: Now the final challenge: eight questions from the whole lesson. Answer out loud before you hear me.

custom.title: Challenge 1
custom.card: Question 1/8 · My name is Sami
say: Let's start easy. How do you say: my name is Sami?

custom.title: Challenge answer 1
custom.card: اسْمِي سَامِي · *ismii Saamii* · My name is Sami

custom.title: Challenge 2
custom.card: Question 2/8 · I'm from Syria. And you?
say: Next, say that you are from Syria, and ask the other person back.

custom.title: Challenge answer 2
custom.card: أَنَا مِنْ سُورِيَا. وَأَنْتِ؟ · *ana min suuriyaa. wa-anti?* · I'm from Syria. And you?

custom.title: Challenge 3
custom.card: Question 3/8 · my mother
say: How do you say: my mother?

custom.title: Challenge answer 3
custom.card: أُمِّي · *ummii* · my mother

custom.title: Challenge 4
custom.card: Question 4/8 · eight
say: Now a number. How do you say eight?

custom.title: Challenge answer 4
custom.card: ثَمَانِيَةْ · *thamaaniya* · eight

custom.title: Challenge 5
custom.card: Question 5/8 · I want water, please.
say: You are thirsty at the café. Ask for water, politely.

custom.title: Challenge answer 5
custom.card: أُرِيدُ مَاءْ، مِنْ فَضْلِكْ. · *uriidu maa', min faDlik.* · I want water, please.

custom.title: Challenge 6
custom.card: Question 6/8 · Where is the café?
say: You are lost in the old city. How do you ask where the café is?

custom.title: Challenge answer 6
custom.card: أَيْنَ الْمَقْهَى؟ · *ayna l-maqhaa?* · Where is the café?

custom.title: Challenge 7
custom.card: Question 7/8 · I love coffee.
say: Tell someone that you love coffee.

custom.title: Challenge answer 7
custom.card: أُحِبُّ الْقَهْوَةْ. · *uHibbu l-qahwa.* · I love coffee.

custom.title: Challenge 8
custom.card: Question 8/8 · Damascus is beautiful.
say: And the last one, for your trip: Damascus is beautiful.

custom.title: Challenge answer 8
custom.card: دِمَشْقُ جَمِيلَةْ. · *dimashqu jamiila.* · Damascus is beautiful.
